_comment: Benefit catalog for Steven's actual cards (roster confirmed 2026-06-20; fees and current consumer Platinum terms refreshed from issuer sources 2026-08-30). annualFee is the standard U.S. primary-card fee, not account-specific introductory or grandfathered pricing. period: monthly | quarterly | semiannual | annual. amountByMonth overrides the default amount for exceptional months. match.merchants = case-insensitive substrings tested against transaction merchant_name/name; match.categories = Plaid personal_finance_category.primary (TRAVEL, FOOD_AND_DRINK, TRANSPORTATION, ENTERTAINMENT, GENERAL_MERCHANDISE). Empty match => statement-credit or manual tracking only. anchor (optional, for annual) = {"month":1-12,"day":1-31}: use it for cardmember-anniversary credits — set it to YOUR account's anniversary; without it, annual defaults to the calendar year.

benefits.name: Uber Cash
benefits.notes: $15/mo is issued directly to your Uber Cash balance in the Uber app—not as a card statement credit (+$20 bonus in December = $35). Add the card to your Uber wallet; covers Uber rides & Uber Eats. Enrollment required.

benefits.name: Digital Entertainment Credit
benefits.notes: Up to $25/mo on eligible: YouTube Premium/TV, Disney+, Hulu, ESPN streaming, Paramount+, Peacock, NYT, and WSJ. Enrollment required.

benefits.name: Walmart+ Membership Credit
benefits.notes: Covers the $12.95/mo Walmart+ membership (pay with the card). Enrollment required.

benefits.name: Resy Dining Credit
benefits.notes: Up to $100/quarter at Resy restaurants (US). Enrollment required. Posts under the restaurant name, so verify manually.

benefits.name: Lululemon Credit
benefits.notes: Up to $75/quarter at Lululemon. Enrollment required.

benefits.name: FHR Hotel Credit
benefits.notes: Up to $300 (Jan–Jun) and $300 (Jul–Dec) on prepaid Fine Hotels + Resorts / The Hotel Collection bookings via Amex Travel. THC requires at least 2 nights; the booking date determines the half-year window. Posts via Amex Travel, so verify manually.

benefits.name: Airline Fee Credit
benefits.notes: Up to $200/yr in incidental fees (bags, seats) with ONE selected airline. Calendar year. Enrollment required. Airfare, hotels, and rideshare share broad travel categories, so verify this credit manually.

benefits.name: Uber One Membership Credit
benefits.notes: Up to $120/yr covering Uber One membership. Calendar year. Enrollment required.

benefits.name: CLEAR+ Credit
benefits.notes: Up to $219/yr covering a CLEAR+ membership. Calendar year. Enrollment required.

benefits.name: Equinox Credit
benefits.notes: Up to $300/calendar year on an eligible U.S. Equinox club membership or Equinox+ digital subscription. Enrollment required.

benefits.name: Oura Ring Credit
benefits.notes: Up to $200/yr toward an Oura Ring. Calendar year. Enrollment required.

benefits.name: Hilton Resort Credit
benefits.notes: Up to $200 (Jan–Jun) and $200 (Jul–Dec) at participating Hilton resorts.

benefits.name: Airline Flight Credit
benefits.notes: Up to $50/quarter on eligible flight purchases booked directly with airlines or via amextravel.com.

benefits.name: Dining Credit
benefits.notes: Up to $25/mo at restaurants worldwide ($300/yr total). Enrollment required.

benefits.name: Hotel Credit
benefits.notes: $100 off a single hotel stay of $500+ (pre-tax) booked via thankyou.com. Calendar year.

benefits.name: Hotel Credit
benefits.notes: Up to $300/calendar year on 2+ night hotel bookings via thankyou.com.

benefits.name: Splurge Credit
benefits.notes: Up to $200/calendar year at a selected merchant (Best Buy, American Airlines, Live Nation, 1stDibs, etc.).

benefits.name: Blacklane Credit
benefits.notes: Up to $100 (Jan–Jun) and $100 (Jul–Dec) on Blacklane chauffeur service.
